title: Nodes Redraw Camera Ease
summary: Fixed the Semio JS bridge so the RS in-memory GraphQL pipeline works end to end in JS. Added explicit in-memory/open-json session helpers, corrected non-browser WASM loading to use the generated rs pkg directly, disabled browser-only live subscription startup outside DOM runtimes, and fixed store-scoped read documents to include relay cursors so JS collection reads resolve the active store correctly. Replaced the placeholder JS embedded test with a real end-to-end smoke test and validated the supported RS mutation path with uncached Vitest plus console-logged runtime checks for createTag/createConcept/createQuality. Note: RS GraphQL createType/createDesign are still stubbed upstream and were not implemented in this slice.
